name: Ryoujoku Guerilla Gari 3
source:
There is a spaceship called Victoire. It keeps winning and never loses. The ship is controlled by young and beautiful women, and their victory always boosts the morale of the team. But the ship and the crew are sold to the enemy after the war, and confined in prison. There is nothing left to protect themselves...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
有一艘名为“维多利亚”的宇宙飞船。它不断获胜，从未失败。这艘船由年轻漂亮的女性掌控，她们的胜利总是鼓舞着团队的士气。但战后，这艘船和船员被卖给敌人，并被关进监狱。已经没有什么可以保护自己了……

[来自工口游戏商店]
